schema:
CREATE TABLE Ball_by_Ball (
  Ball_Id,
  Bowler,
  Innings_No,
  Match_Id,
  Non_Striker,
  Over_Id,
  Striker,
  Striker_Batting_Position,
  Team_Batting,
  Team_Bowling
);

CREATE TABLE Batsman_Scored (
  Ball_Id,
  Innings_No,
  Match_Id,
  Over_Id,
  Runs_Scored
);

CREATE TABLE Extra_Runs (
  Ball_Id,
  Extra_Runs,
  Extra_Type_Id,
  Innings_No,
  Match_Id,
  Over_Id
);

CREATE TABLE Match (
  Man_of_the_Match,
  Match_Date,
  Match_Id,
  Match_Winner,
  Outcome_type,
  Season_Id,
  Team_1,
  Team_2,
  Toss_Decide,
  Toss_Winner,
  Venue_Id,
  Win_Margin,
  Win_Type
);

CREATE TABLE Player (
  Batting_hand,
  Bowling_skill,
  Country_Name,
  DOB,
  Player_Id,
  Player_Name
);

CREATE TABLE Season (
  Man_of_the_Series,
  Orange_Cap,
  Purple_Cap,
  Season_Id,
  Season_Year
);

CREATE TABLE Wicket_Taken (
  Ball_Id,
  Fielders,
  Innings_No,
  Kind_Out,
  Match_Id,
  Over_Id,
  Player_Out
);
